h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Phusro

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Phusro

items.pText: Phusro is a coal town in the Bermo area of Bokaro district, on the Damodar in Jharkhand. Schools, colliery colonies and housing areas here often have limited staff to look after a playground once it is installed. If nobody is going to repaint, oil or replace parts often, the choice of material matters more than usual.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,440 km from Phusro, and sends it to Jharkhand by road. A dealer in Jharkhand or our own installation team then fixes it on site. We do not have detailed knowledge of every neighbourhood in Phusro, so we plan each site from the photos and measurements you send. Tell us the age group of the children and how the ground is used, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Choosing equipment that needs little upkeep

c: Roto-moulded plastic has its colour moulded through the material, so it does not need repainting. Galvanised steel is protected by a zinc coating instead of paint alone. Together they need little more than washing to stay in good condition, which helps in a town where coal dust settles on everything.

have no moving parts to service. Keep swings and spring riders to a few, and check their springs and bearings regularly. Those parts carry a one-year warranty, and the frames and roto-moulded parts carry three years.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,440 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What equipment needs the least maintenance in Phusro?
items.a: Fixed pieces made of roto-moulded plastic and galvanised steel, such as slides and climbers. Wash them down from time to time to clear coal dust.

items.q: Do you deliver to Phusro and Bokaro district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Phusro, Bokaro and Dhanbad, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment.

items.q: Does coal dust damage playground equipment?
items.a: It mainly affects moving parts and makes surfaces grimy. Regular washing and checks on springs and bearings keep the equipment in good order.
